summary: Lewis Hamilton spearheads Aston Martin's championship assault with a potent new upgrade package that delivered Friday's fastest times ahead of Ferrari rival Charles Leclerc. Fernando Alonso's prospects pivot on whether Aston Martin's mechanical overhaul translates from practice to race day, potentially reshaping the constructors' battle. A strong showing at the Hungaroring could cement either team's mid-season momentum and reshape the fight for podium positions in the championship standings.
